title: Ghostlands
body: South of the Elrendar River the forests of Quel'Thalas give way to the Ghostlands, a country that never recovered from the Third War. The Dead Scar runs across it from the Scourge citadel of Deatholme, where the traitor Dar'Khan Drathir commands the undead. Ghosts haunt the empty villages and plague runs in the blood of the beasts. Against him stand the blood elves of Tranquillien and their Forsaken allies, the magisters of the Sanctum of the Sun and the Farstriders, while Shadowpine trolls hold the road to Zul'Aman.

title: Tranquillien
body: Tranquillien was abandoned when Quel'Thalas fell, and it is now the blood elves' foothold in the Ghostlands. Dame Auriferous governs it, and Forsaken soldiers under High Executor Mavren hold its western tower, a sight that still unsettles some of the sin'dorei. The two quarrel over the war: Mavren would strike straight at Deatholme, while the dame means first to win back the outlying villages of Suncrown, Goldenmist and Windrunner.

title: Suncrown Village
body: The people of Suncrown held a yearly rite to show their mastery over nature, summoning and binding the water elemental Aquantion in Lake Elrendar. One year the rite ended in disaster, and the drowned villagers haunt the lake still. Since the Scourge came, nerubians have claimed the ruins of the village.

title: Farstrider Enclave
body: The Farstrider Enclave on the southern shore of Lake Elrendar is cut off from the other elven holdings, hemmed in by haunted water and Shadowpine trolls. Captain Helios means to break the trolls before he turns on Deatholme, a choice the Forsaken call senseless skirmishing. It began badly: Lieutenant Tomathren led his rangers against Zeb'Sora without scouting first, and many died.

title: The Dead Scar
body: The Dead Scar begins at Deatholme and runs north through the heart of the Ghostlands into Eversong, a ribbon of dead ground left by the Scourge's march. Mindless undead still follow it, and in its middle the Scourge has raised two ziggurats, the Bleeding and the Howling, where Dar'Khan's darkmages keep watch and his abominations roam.

title: An'daroth, An'telas and An'owyn
body: Three old ley-line nexuses of the high elves lie scattered across the Ghostlands. Night elves have come to them: Sentinel spies hold An'daroth and An'owyn, and beside them stand strange objects like small, magically grown trees with glowing orbs atop them. At An'telas a magister studies the nexus energy for use against the Scourge.

parts.body: The strange trees are moon crystals, scrying devices the night elves meant to spy on the sin'dorei with, and An'owyn holds power enough to drive them.

title: Sanctum of the Sun
body: South of Sungraze Peak, some of Silvermoon's most powerful magisters have rebuilt an old arcane sanctum as a banner of defiance before Deatholme. Under Magister Kaendris they study the Scourge's weaknesses with the Forsaken's help, holding that guile and arcane learning, not force alone, will win back the Ghostlands, while his colleague Idonis chafes at every delay.

title: Windrunner Spire
body: Windrunner Spire was the seat of the Windrunners and the home of Sylvanas Windrunner, once ranger-general of Quel'Thalas and now queen of the Forsaken. The Scourge holds it today, its grounds walked by cultists and the risen bodies of fallen rangers, and in the village below the Scourge posted its stronger shock troops, shades and gargoyles. The Forsaken of Tranquillien count its recapture an honor.

title: Deatholme
body: Deatholme is the Scourge citadel in the southwest of the Ghostlands, where the Dead Scar begins. From the Tower of the Damned at its heart Dar'Khan Drathir rules the undead of the region through four lieutenants, and the fortress has only one way in or out. Its prisoners are tortured with will-breaking poisons, and near the tower lies the body of a Blood Knight who led a failed assault.

title: Hatchet Hills and the Amani Pass
body: In the eastern Ghostlands the land climbs through the Hatchet Hills to the Amani Pass, the gateway to Zul'Aman, capital of the forest trolls. A treasure hunter's camp stands at the foot of the pass, complete with a flight master, provisioners and hangers-on, and bodyguards hold the road above it.

parts.body: Budd Nedreck, a human adventurer and famous by his own account, holds court in the camp, sure of vast treasure in Zul'Aman and forever looking for others hungry enough to go in ahead of him.

title: Dar'Khan Drathir
body: Dar'Khan Drathir was a magister of Quel'Thalas who spent long nights scheming in Dawnstar Spire on Lake Elrendar, and came to despise his own people. When Arthas marched north, Dar'Khan pledged himself to the Scourge, helped it past the kingdom's defenses and plotted to steal the Sunwell's power. Now he commands the Scourge of the Ghostlands from the Tower of the Damned in Deatholme.

parts.body: His journal told of two elven treasures he had promised the Scourge, the stone of light and the stone of flame, charged with the Sunwell's energies and attuned to ward against the undead.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Dar'Khan_Drathir (helped Arthas slip through Thalassian defenses; killed by the death knight per Arthas: Rise of the Lich King)

parts.body: Armed with those very stones, a champion of Tranquillien slew him in his tower, and his head was carried to the regent lord in Silvermoon.
